data.title: Speeding fine (Bußgeldbescheid) – €98.50
data.summary: The Kreis Musterland fines office (Bußgeldstelle) issued a fine for driving 23 km/h over the limit on 25 August 2026. The total is €98.50, plus 1 point in the driving-fitness register. The notice was delivered on 19 September 2026.
data.explanation: You are accused of speeding 23 km/h over the limit outside built-up areas. The total is €98.50 (fine €70, fee €25, expenses €3.50), and 1 point will be recorded. You can file an objection (Einspruch) in writing or record it at the fines office. The app shows the deadline, which counts from the delivery date on the envelope. If you don't object, the decision becomes final and enforceable, and you must pay within two weeks of that. If you disagree, consider getting legal advice before the deadline.

items.title: Object to the fine (Einspruch)
items.quote: Sie können gegen diesen Bescheid binnen zwei Wochen nach Zustellung Einspruch einlegen – schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift beim Kreis Musterland – Bußgeldstelle.
items.action: If you disagree, file an objection in writing or record it at the fines office.
items.consequence: Without an objection the decision becomes final and enforceable.

items.title: Pay the fine
items.quote: Bitte zahlen Sie den Gesamtbetrag spätestens zwei Wochen nach Rechtskraft unter Angabe des Aktenzeichens auf das unten genannte Konto.
items.action: Pay €98.50 quoting the file number, within two weeks after the decision becomes final.
items.consequence: The decision becomes enforceable if unpaid.
